title: Risk score record
description: Risk scores of one patient at the start of a systemic therapy line, computed from the baseline record. One record per patient, linked by patient_id. Risks are probabilities between 0 and 1.

patient_id.title: Patient ID
patient_id.description: Identifier of the patient, as in the baseline record.

model_version.title: Model version
model_version.description: Version of the model configuration that produced the scores.

severe_toxicity_90d_risk.title: Risk of severe toxicity in 90 days
severe_toxicity_90d_risk.description: Candidate 1: probability of at least one adverse event of CTCAE grade 3 to 5 within 90 days of therapy start.

severe_toxicity_90d_regimen_rate.title: Regimen rate of severe toxicity
severe_toxicity_90d_regimen_rate.description: Candidate 1: risk of the reference patient (age 65, ECOG 0 or 1, no impaired geriatric domain) on the same regimen. Equals the published rate of the regimen.

severe_toxicity_90d_category.title: Risk category, severe toxicity
severe_toxicity_90d_category.description: Candidate 1: risk category from the thresholds in the model configuration.

ild_applicable.title: Lung toxicity model applies
ild_applicable.description: Candidate 2: true if the model has a lung toxicity rate for the regimen. If false, the other ild fields are null.

ild_risk.title: Risk of lung toxicity
ild_risk.description: Candidate 2: probability of drug-related interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis of any grade within 730 days.

ild_grade2plus_risk.title: Risk of lung toxicity, grade 2 or higher
ild_grade2plus_risk.description: Candidate 2: probability of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis of grade 2 or higher within 730 days.

ild_regimen_rate.title: Regimen rate of lung toxicity
ild_regimen_rate.description: Candidate 2: published rate of the regimen, i.e. the mean risk in the trial population.

ild_category.title: Risk category, lung toxicity
ild_category.description: Candidate 2: risk category from the thresholds in the model configuration.
